description: Welcome to this beautifully updated home in the highly sought-after Carlton Terrace neighborhood of Woodland Hills. Designed for both comfortable living and effortless entertaining, the open-concept floor plan is highlighted by soaring vaulted ceilings, rich hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and an abundance of natural light that fills the home throughout the day. The versatile layout features two spacious primary suites, each with its own private bathroom, creating the perfect setup for multigenerational living, guests, or a luxurious home office retreat. Generous storage space can be found throughout the home, adding both convenience and functionality. Ideally located just minutes from Warner Center, The Village, premier shopping, dining, and entertainment, this home offers the best of Woodland Hills living. Step outside to a thoughtfully sized backyard designed for alfresco dining, weekend gatherings, and relaxing summer evenings under the stars. Large enough to enjoy, yet manageable enough to avoid excessive maintenance and watering costs, it’s the perfect balance of outdoor living and practicality. A rare opportunity to own a light-filled, move-in-ready home in one of Woodland Hills’ most desirable neighborhoods.
